segments.name: Clearing
segments.description: Provides clearing and settlement services for financial derivatives and commodities contracts.
segments.evidence: Clearing net commission income increased $ 12.4 m to $ 275.4 m (2024: $ 263.0 m) , reflecting increased client activity and volumes as contracts cleared increased to 1,280 m (2024: 1,116 m).

segments.name: Agency and Execution
segments.description: Provides agency and execution services across securities, energy and other asset classes for clients.
segments.evidence: Agency and Execution revenue increased $ 354.0 m to $ 1,049.2 m (2024: $ 695.2 m), reflecting strong growth in Securities and Energy.

segments.name: Market Making
segments.description: Provides market making services across metals, securities, energy and agricultural commodities.
segments.evidence: Market Making revenue increased $ 27.7 m to $ 235.5 m in 2025 (2024: $ 207.8 m), driven by strong growth in Metals, Securities and Energy, which more than offset softer conditions in Agriculture highlighting the resilience of our multi-asset approach in Market Making amid a mixed market backdrop in 2025, driven by rising tariffs and heightened uncertainty.

segments.name: Hedging and Investment Solutions
segments.description: Provides hedging solutions and structured investment products to clients across asset classes.
segments.evidence: Solutions revenue increased $ 35.3 m to $ 196.8 m (2024: $ 161.5 m), reflecting higher client activity across both Financial Products and Hedging Solutions .

revenueModel.text: Clients pay commissions for execution and clearing services, net interest income from client balances, and net trading income from market making and proprietary positions.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue increased by $ 429.4 m to $ 2,024.1 m (2024: $ 1,594.7 m), with growth across all operating segments and contributions from acquisitions completed during the year.
